subject: chemistry
question_text: Describe the Maxwell distribution of molecular speeds. What happens to the distribution when the temperature is raised?

verification.note: PREDICTED, not asked. steps.label: The shape of the distribution
lines: The molecules of a gas do not all move at one
speed — the speeds are spread over a range.
Plotting the fraction of molecules against speed
· it starts at zero (no molecules at rest),
· rises to a maximum at the most probable
· then falls, with a long tail at high speeds.
U(mp) < U(av) < U(rms) all sit on this curve.
steps.why: Collisions continuously exchange energy between molecules, so a single shared speed is impossible; a stable spread with one peak is what remains, and the peak position defines the most probable speed.
common_mistakes: Drawing or describing a symmetric curve. The high-speed tail makes it unsymmetric.
Placing the average or RMS speed at the peak. The PEAK is the most probable speed; the other two lie to its right.
steps.memory_tip: Rise, peak at most probable, long tail — and the three named speeds sit left to right: mp, average, rms.
steps.margin_note: The three bullet features are the marked description; a labelled sketch may replace the words.

steps.label: The effect of temperature
lines: · the peak shifts to a higher speed (all three
· the peak becomes lower and the curve broader —
the speeds are spread over a wider range,
· the total area under the curve stays the same,
since it counts all the molecules.

lines.text: Higher temperature: peak moves to higher speed, curve becomes lower and broader

steps.why: Heating raises the average kinetic energy, moving the whole spread toward higher speeds; and since the same molecules now cover a wider range of speeds, the fraction at any one speed drops, flattening the peak.
common_mistakes: Raising the peak with temperature. The peak LOWERS as the curve broadens.
Changing the area under the curve. The molecule count is fixed, so the area is fixed.
steps.memory_tip: Hotter gas: same area, wider spread — so the peak must sit lower and farther right.
steps.margin_note: Constant area is the understanding check examiners reward.
